import sys,re,warnings,datetime,json; warnings.simplefilter('ignore'); sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from flask import Flask
from flask_babel import Babel
from flask_admin import Admin
from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy
from flask_admin.contrib.sqla import ModelView
app=Flask(__name__); app.config['SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI']='sqlite://'; app.secret_key='x'
Babel(app); db=SQLAlchemy(app)
class User(db.Model):
    id=db.Column(db.Integer,primary_key=True); name=db.Column(db.String(50),nullable=False); active=db.Column(db.Boolean,default=True); born=db.Column(db.Date)
    posts=db.relationship('Post',backref='user')
class Post(db.Model):
    id=db.Column(db.Integer,primary_key=True); title=db.Column(db.String(50)); user_id=db.Column(db.Integer,db.ForeignKey(User.id))
class UV(ModelView):
    column_filters=['active','born','name']; inline_models=[Post]; column_editable_list=['name']; column_default_sort='id'
class PV(ModelView):
    form_ajax_refs={'user':{'fields':['name']}}; column_filters=['user.name']; column_list=['title','user','user.name']
admin=Admin(app); admin.add_view(UV(User,db.session)); admin.add_view(PV(Post,db.session))
with app.app_context():
    db.create_all()
    for i in range(5):
        u=User(name=f'u{i}',active=i%2==0,born=datetime.date(2000+i,1,1)); db.session.add(u); db.session.add(Post(title=f'p{i}',user=u))
    db.session.commit()
c=app.test_client()
N=lambda d,col='name': [x.decode() for x in re.findall(rb'col-'+col.encode()+rb'">\s*([^<]*?)\s*<',d)]
def g(u,col='name'):
    r=c.get(u); print(u, r.status_code, N(r.data,col) if r.status_code==200 else r.data[-300:])
v=admin._views[1]
with app.test_request_context(): fl=[(i,f.name,f.operation()) for i,f in enumerate(v._filters)]
print(fl)
for i,n,op in fl:
    val={'equals':'1','not equal':'1'}.get(str(op),'1')
    if n=='Born':
        val={'between':'2001-01-01 to 2003-01-01','not between':'2001-01-01 to 2003-01-01'}.get(str(op),'2002-01-01')
    if n=='Name': continue
    g(f'/admin/user/?flt0_{i}={val}')
g('/admin/post/','title'); g('/admin/post/?flt0_0=u3','title')
r=c.get('/admin/post/ajax/lookup/?name=user&query=u2'); print('ajax',r.status_code,r.data[:200])
r=c.post('/admin/user/new/',data={'name':''}); print('validation (expect 200 w/ error)',r.status_code, b'This field is required' in r.data)
r=c.post('/admin/user/edit/?id=1',data={'name':'u0x','active':'y','born':'2000-01-01','posts-0-id':'1','posts-0-title':'p0x','posts-1-title':'newpost'}); print('inline edit',r.status_code)
r=c.post('/admin/user/ajax/update/',data={'list_form_pk':'2','name':'u1x'}); print('inline list edit',r.status_code,r.data[:100])
r=c.post('/admin/user/action/',data={'action':'delete','rowid':['4','5']}); print('bulk delete',r.status_code)
r=c.get('/admin/user/edit/?id=1'); print('edit form shows date', b'2000-01-01' in r.data)
with app.app_context():
    print([(u.id,u.name,u.active,u.born,[p.title for p in u.posts]) for u in User.query.all()])
EOF

content.text:
I still haven't found anything broken, and I've now tested most of what Flask-Admin does.

This round covered relationships and inline forms in your copy, using the venv at `<scratch>/venv` with `Babel(app)` set up. Everything worked:
- **Filters:** yes/no, date (equals, not equal, greater than, smaller than, between, not between), empty, and filtering posts by the related user's name all returned the right rows.
- **Relationships:** the user search box (`form_ajax_refs`) found the right user, and the post list shows its related user.
- **Saving:** editing a user together with their posts in one form saved both. It updated an existing post and added a new one. Editing a name directly in the list also saved.
- **Bulk delete** removed exactly the rows I selected.
- **Validation:** submitting an empty required field shows "This field is required" instead of saving.
- **Dates** display correctly on the edit form.

Earlier rounds covered listing, paging, search, sort, create, edit, delete, CSV export and the example apps.

The only real failure I've reproduced is the setup issue from before. In that venv, any app that doesn't call `Babel(app)` crashes on every admin page with `KeyError: 'babel'`.

I've hit the limit of guessing. "Still not working properly" doesn't tell me what's going wrong, and nothing I've tested fails. To get any further I need one of these:
- **The error.** Paste the traceback, or the last few lines of the terminal output.
- **The command.** How you start it, for example `python examples/sqla/main.py` or your own app's file.
- **The symptom.** What you click and what happens versus what you expect, for example "the edit page saves but the date resets."

If it's your own app outside this folder, give me its path and I'll run it directly. I haven't changed any files.
